basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old aerospace engineer based in Manchester, UK. My passion lies in rocketry and propulsion systems, and I've been dabbling in building liquid-fueled rocket engines in my spare time. I enjoy discussing niche technical topics and often contribute to communities that share these interests. Outside of work, I'm an avid gamer and love exploring the intersection of technology and personal hobbies. I'm single, and my typical online hours are evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering from a leading UK university and have been working in the aerospace industry for over a decade. My expertise extends to propulsion systems and regulatory compliance within the UK aerospace sector. I actively seek out new knowledge through self-teaching and participation in specialized forums.
